source_text: Non tres integrae tribus per Moysen nec novem integrae per Iesum, sed duae semis et novem semis — una tribus dividitur. Indicatur quod priores per legem contigerunt scientiam Trinitatis non integre sed ex parte; deerat de Unigeniti incarnatione cognoscere. Multi prophetae et iusti cupierunt videre quae vos videtis et non viderunt. Ideo neque duae ne patres extra Trinitatis fidem sint, neque tres integrae ne sacramentum iam expletum videretur. Altare quod sibi fecerunt non verum sed typum veri altaris apud Iesum — ideo nec multi reges ab illis deiecti: Seon et Og tantum. Iesus ubi ducit, quinque reges cadunt et suspenduntur in ligno; viginti novem iugulantur; immunditiae de terra sancta exterminantur.
pass_a_gloss: Not three whole tribes through Moses nor nine whole through Jesus, but two half and nine half — one tribe is-divided. Is-indicated that earlier-ones through law touched knowledge of-Trinity not wholly but from part; it-was-lacking concerning of-Only-begotten incarnation to-know. Many prophets and righteous desired to-see things which you see and not they-saw. Therefore neither two lest fathers outside of-Trinity faith be, nor three whole lest sacrament already completed should-seem. Altar which for-themselves they-made not true but type of-true altar with Jesus — therefore nor many kings by them cast-down: Sihon and Og only. Jesus where leads, five kings fall and are-hung on wood; twenty-nine are-slaughtered; uncleannesses from land holy are-exterminated.
pass_b_english: Not three whole tribes under Moses nor nine whole under Jesus, but two and a half and nine and a half — one tribe is split. This signals that those under the law touched knowledge of the Trinity only [[in part >> Bible:1 Corinthians 13:9]]; they still lacked full knowledge of the Only-begotten’s incarnation. [[Many prophets and righteous longed to see what you see and did not see it >> Bible:Matthew 13:17]]. So they are neither two alone — lest the fathers be left outside Trinitarian faith — nor three complete — lest the sacrament seem already fulfilled in them. The altar they built was not the true altar but a type of the true one with Jesus; hence they overthrew few hostile kings — only [[Sihon and Og >> Bible:Numbers 21:21-35]]. Where Jesus leads the army, [[five kings fall and are hanged on the tree >> Bible:Joshua 10:26]]; twenty-nine are cut down; every uncleanness that held the holy land in malice’s bitterness is wiped out.
